name: solvebeam/twinfield
description: Modern PHP SDK for the Twinfield API

suggest.symfony/http-client: For using Symfony's lightweight PSR-18 HTTP client instead of Guzzle
suggest.php-http/curl-client: For using pure cURL-based PSR-18 HTTP client
suggest.nyholm/psr7: For a lightweight PSR-7 implementation with the HTTP client
suggest.monolog/monolog: For PSR-3 logging of HTTP requests and responses
suggest.php-http/logger-plugin: For logging HTTP traffic (requires monolog or another PSR-3 logger)
suggest.php-http/message: For HTTP message formatters (FullHttpMessageFormatter for complete request/response logging)

scripts-descriptions.test:live: Run read-only tests against the live Twinfield API
scripts-descriptions.test:write: Run write tests on a test administration, after confirmation
scripts-descriptions.twinfield: Try live Twinfield calls (whoami, refresh, finder)
scripts-descriptions.twinfield:login: Log in to Twinfield once and store the refresh token
scripts-descriptions.twinfield:anonymize: Turn recorded responses into anonymized fixtures
scripts-descriptions.twinfield:setup: Guided setup: credentials, login and default company
scripts-descriptions.twinfield:browse-definitions: Save the browse definitions and browse fields in browse-definitions/
scripts-descriptions.docs:xml: Write the request and response XML into the example READMEs
